# Fetch all Venmo transactions sent today (all pages)
venmo_all = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_login['access_token'],
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-20',
        max_created_at='2023-05-20',
        page_index=page,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not result:
        break
    venmo_all.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Total Venmo transactions today:", len(venmo_all))
for t in venmo_all:
    print(t['transaction_id'], t['amount'], t['description'], t['receiver']['email'])
